Application Data.NAME: First National Bank of Springfield
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: First National Bank of Springfield provides a wide range of financial services, including personal and commercial banking, lending, investment management, and wealth advisory services. The institution is committed to maintaining a robust cybersecurity infrastructure to protect customer data and prevent cyber threats. With a strong focus on regulatory compliance, the bank implements comprehensive policies and procedures to ensure adherence to federal and state banking regulations. Additionally, business continuity plans are in place to safeguard operations against potential disruptions, ensuring continuous service to our clients. The bank also prioritizes community engagement and financial education initiatives, supporting local economic growth and fostering strong relationships with customers.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a phishing attack resulted in unauthorized access to a limited number of customer accounts, totaling approximately $5,000 in fraudulent transactions. The bank swiftly implemented stronger cybersecurity measures and informed affected customers. The incident was fully addressed by April 1, 2022, and no further issues have arisen since.

Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Perimeter fencing with monitored security cameras and on-site security personnel during non-business hours.
